summary:
SynapseEdge vNext Hardening & Measurement Integrity Plan covering:
1. Fail-Closed Watchdog Architecture & Community Seed Generalization (escalating unrecognized proposals unless explicitly safe-matched).
2. Strict Control vs. Measured Telemetry Separation (refactoring closedLoopHomeostasis to output control deltas only, preserving independent measurement and provenance).
3. Express API Authentication & Per-IP Rate Limiting (requiring Firebase auth on state-mutating and export routes, and rate-limiting AI consumption routes).
4. Empirical SAE Matrix Orthogonality Calculation & CI Workflow Alignment (replacing hardcoded 0.998/0.0 diagnostics with live cosine-similarity Gram-Schmidt inner-product calculations and aligning CI with Vite, esbuild, TypeScript, and benchmark validation).
